d:
The Heat defeated the Bucks, 137-130 tonight in Miami. Giannis Antetokounmpo contributed a team-high 27 points to go with 14 rebounds and 9 assists, with Bam Adebayo of the Heat adding an additional 26 points (7-15 FG, 3-8 3P) in the game. Kyle Kuzma finished with a team-high 26 points along with 5 rebounds for the Bucks in the losing effort. The Heat improve their record to 9-6 with the win, while the Bucks fall to 1-14 for the season.
